description_text: BPL’s official catalogue distinguishes the single-outlet Oxy 5 Neo from the double-outlet Oxy 5 Neo Dual. It lists 0.5–5 L/min, 95.5% oxygen concentration (flow-specific conditions not stated), a built-in nebulizer, usage-hour LCD, and low-oxygen, power-failure, compressor-failure, and pressure-cycle-failure alarms. The low-O₂ alarm does not establish an OPI display. The checked catalogue entry does not establish weight, sound, or power. Confirm the exact Neo/Neo Dual variant, model-specific sheet, price, package, warranty, and service with the seller. Source: https://www.bplmedicaltechnologies.com/product-catalogue/all-product-catalogue.pdf.
